name: Morgado de Mateus Apartment, Sao Paulo (traced)
note: Traced by hand on the cached plan (1280 x 768 px). No scale bar, dimensions or room areas: 74 px/m from the published 115 m2 (traced net rooms 101 m2, 88%), cross-checked with the furniture: queen bed 122 x 149 px = 1.65 x 2.0 m, kitchen counter 47 px = 0.64 m, entrance door 64 px = 0.86 m, fridge 0.8 m. Rooms at the inner wall faces. Rooms by photo and furniture: the master bedroom is L-shaped (its wardrobe wall and the passage to the ensuite are part of it); the kids room (Bedroom 2) and the study/TV room are split by a full-height wardrobe, traced as a wall; the windowless desk room off the laundry is 'Office'; the shared bathroom with its shower bay and the powder room (WC) are polygons; the linen cupboard between the hall and the WC is left out; the bookcase between the WC and the dining area is treated as furniture (the dining edge is on the WC wall). The kitchen is open to the dining area; the laundry is behind a glazed partition with a door. Two entrances (social into the living room, service by the dining/kitchen), a pivot door between the hall and the dining area. The duct in the kitchen counter is a notch in the kitchen. Kitchen as drawn: laundry counter with the tank, a short counter, the main run with hob and double sink under the window, a fridge column.
